work_items.title: TryUnprotect resilience on IFleetKeyProtector + adoption in GeoConfigEndpoint and MapyKeyResolver
acceptance_criteria: AC#4: A previously-stored raw/undecryptable value no longer 500s the map. `string? TryUnprotect(string?)` is added to IFleetKeyProtector and implemented in FleetKeyProtector: returns null on null/empty input AND on System.Security.Cryptography.CryptographicException; otherwise the plaintext.

GeoConfigEndpoint (line ~71) resolves the browser key via keyProtector.TryUnprotect(settings?.MapyBrowserKey) ?? configuration["Mapy:BrowserKey"] ?? string.Empty — a raw/legacy value falls back instead of throwing.
MapyKeyResolver.Resolve uses keyProtector.TryUnprotect(ciphertext) (not Unprotect) so an un-decryptable server key falls back to configuration["Mapy__ServerKey"] instead of throwing.
Unprotect(string?) is left unchanged (still part of the interface); the new behavior is additive.
Neither Mapy key value is ever logged (rules/logging.md).
test_cases: FleetKeyProtectorTests: TryUnprotect_ValidCiphertext_ReturnsPlaintext (Protect then TryUnprotect round-trips).
FleetKeyProtectorTests: TryUnprotect_RawNonCiphertextValue_ReturnsNull (a literal raw key string does not throw, returns null).
FleetKeyProtectorTests: TryUnprotect_NullOrEmpty_ReturnsNull.

GeoConfigTests: HandleAsync_FleetHasRawBrowserKey_ReturnsFallbackNot500 — seed FleetSettings.MapyBrowserKey with a raw (non-ciphertext) string; GET /geo/config returns 200 with the configured fallback browser key, no CryptographicException / 500 (regression for the documented current bug).
GeoConfigTests: existing happy-path (protected browser key decrypts and is returned) still green.
Gate: dotnet build -warnaserror clean; full dotnet test green (run via the user-local dotnet SDK — bare `dotnet` is SDK 9 and fails NETSDK1045).
work_items.notes: Write the RED test first (raw-value GeoConfig regression + TryUnprotect unit) then implement. Additive change only — do not alter Unprotect. TryUnprotect is a single try/catch around _protector.Unprotect returning null on CryptographicException. This WI is the root of the API lane; WI-2's GET depends on TryUnprotect for the browser-key field.

work_items.title: GetTenantSettings + UpdateTenantSettings SuperAdmin slices (+ validator, ErrorCodes, integration/validator tests, OpenAPI allowlist, docs/api.md, API-KEYS.md §1.3)
files_touched: docs/api.md (regenerated by OpenApi_Document_GeneratesApiMarkdown — stage, do not hand-edit)
acceptance_criteria: AC#1: GET admin/fleets/{id:guid}/settings (SuperAdminOnly, DontCatchExceptions) loads Fleet + FleetSettings by id with IgnoreQueryFilters() + AsNoTracking(); 404 if the fleet does not exist; if no FleetSettings row, returns entity defaults. Response carries every editable Fleet field (name, phone, currency, timeZone, primaryColorHex, isActive) and FleetSettings field (offerTimeoutSeconds, autoDispatchEnabled, autoDispatchAfterSeconds, maxOfferRadiusKm, smsSenderName, welcomeText, smsMonthlyCapCzk, smsUnitCostCzk, mapCenterLat, mapCenterLng, mapZoom, geoMonthlyCreditBudget).

AC#3 (security, non-negotiable): GET response carries mapyBrowserKey (public — decrypted via keyProtector.TryUnprotect from WI-1; null if unset/undecryptable) AND mapyServerKeyConfigured: bool ONLY. The server-key plaintext/ciphertext value is STRUCTURALLY ABSENT from GetTenantSettingsResponse — there is no field that could carry it.

AC#1 write: PUT admin/fleets/{id:guid}/settings (SuperAdminOnly, DontCatchExceptions) loads Fleet + FleetSettings by id with IgnoreQueryFilters() (tracked); upserts a FleetSettings row if missing (mirror UpdateFleetSettingsEndpoint); assigns all fields; stamps currentTenant.FleetId = id BEFORE SaveChangesAsync (inject CurrentTenant concrete, the sanctioned cross-tenant write per CreateFleet/DeactivateFleet); returns 204; 404 if the fleet does not exist.

AC#2/#3 (Mapy key write semantics, applied identically to MapyServerKey and MapyBrowserKey): request field null -> leave the column unchanged (keep); empty string "" -> set the column to null (clear); non-empty -> store keyProtector.Protect(value). This lets a blank write-only server-key field preserve the existing key.

Request DTO (UpdateTenantSettingsRequest): plain { get; init; } properties, NO C# `required` (STJ 500-trap, CLAUDE.md WI-11); mapCenterLat/Lng are `double` (body binding uses STJ invariant parsing — the FastEndpoints query-binding locale trap does not apply to body). Mirror UpdateFleetSettingsRequest as a plain class.

Response DTO (GetTenantSettingsResponse): property-based record ({ get; init; } with /// <summary> on each) — NOT a large positional record — to avoid CS1573 all-or-nothing <param> tags under -warnaserror.
Both endpoints are internal sealed and reuse `new AdminFeatureConfiguration()` (do NOT create a new feature configuration).

UpdateTenantSettingsValidator (internal sealed : Validator<UpdateTenantSettingsRequest>) mirrors UpdateFleetSettingsValidator: reuses existing ErrorCodes.Validation.* (FleetNameRequired, PhoneRequired, PrimaryColorInvalid when non-empty ^#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$, OfferTimeoutRange 10..600, SmsCapNonNegative, WelcomeTextTooLong <=2000); adds new ErrorCodes.Validation.* for: timeZone required, currency 3-letter code, autoDispatchAfterSeconds >= 0, maxOfferRadiusKm 1..100, smsUnitCostCzk >= 0, smsSenderName <=100 when set, mapCenterLat -90..90, mapCenterLng -180..180, mapZoom 1..20, geoMonthlyCreditBudget >= 0, mapyServerKey/mapyBrowserKey <=512 when set.
New ErrorCodes.Validation.* constants added to Common/ErrorCodes.cs with /// <summary>, stable "Validation.{Name}" format.

AC#8: The OpenAPI allowlist `expected` set in SeedAndEndToEndTests.cs gains `GET /api/v1/admin/fleets/{id}/settings` and `PUT /api/v1/admin/fleets/{id}/settings` (constraint-stripped {id}, per the CLAUDE.md OpenAPI fact); the sibling OpenApi_Document_GeneratesApiMarkdown test regenerates docs/api.md — stage it.
AC#6: only a SuperAdmin token reaches the endpoints; FleetAdmin/driver/customer -> 403; unknown fleet -> 404; the write targets only the specified fleet.
Neither Mapy key value is logged anywhere (rules/logging.md).

docs/API-KEYS.md §1.3: targeted Edit only — replace the 'no settings UI yet' note with 'Mapy keys are now set in /admin -> fleet -> Edit, encrypted server-side'; keep the env/appsettings fallback + Data-Protection key-ring warning; note the write-only server-key contract. Preserve the rest of the file (it is pre-staged by the user).
test_cases: TenantSettingsTests: SuperAdmin_UpdatesAnotherFleetSettings_Returns204AndRowChanged — PUT as SuperAdmin against a non-owned fleet returns 204; re-reading via IgnoreQueryFilters shows the changed values.

TenantSettingsTests: MapyServerKey_RoundTripsThroughRealProtector — after PUT with a plaintext server key, the stored MapyServerKey column ciphertext != plaintext AND MapyKeyResolver.Resolve returns the original plaintext (proves Protect+TryUnprotect through the real IFleetKeyProtector; use the real DI protector, not a fake).

TenantSettingsTests: Get_Response_HasConfiguredFlagButNoServerKeyValue — GET returns mapyServerKeyConfigured true after a key is set, and the serialized JSON contains no field carrying the server-key value.
TenantSettingsTests: Put_BlankServerKey_KeepsExistingKey — set key, then PUT with mapyServerKey=null (omitted); stored ciphertext unchanged and still decrypts to the original.
TenantSettingsTests: Put_EmptyStringServerKey_ClearsKey — PUT with mapyServerKey="" sets the column to null; GET shows mapyServerKeyConfigured=false.
TenantSettingsTests: Put_MapyBrowserKey_SameKeepClearSetSemantics — mirror the three branches for the browser key.
TenantSettingsTests: NonSuperAdmin_Returns403 — FleetAdmin (or driver) token -> 403 on both GET and PUT.
TenantSettingsTests: UnknownFleet_Returns404 — random Guid -> 404 on both GET and PUT.
TenantSettingsTests: InvalidBody_Returns400 — e.g. bad primaryColorHex or offerTimeoutSeconds out of range -> 400 with the stable error code.
TenantSettingsTests: Get_FleetWithNoSettingsRow_ReturnsDefaults — GET a fleet with no FleetSettings returns entity defaults (offerTimeout 45, mapZoom 12, etc.).
UpdateTenantSettingsValidatorTests: one .TestValidate(...) case per rule asserting .WithErrorCode(...) for each new and reused code.
SeedAndEndToEndTests.OpenApi_Document_ListsAllExpectedEndpoints passes with the two new allowlist entries; OpenApi_Document_GeneratesApiMarkdown regenerates docs/api.md.
Gate: dotnet build -warnaserror clean; full dotnet test green (user-local dotnet SDK).
work_items.notes: TDD: write failing endpoint + validator + integration tests first. Use the CurrentTenant CONCRETE type (not ICurrentTenant) so you can set FleetId — mirror CreateFleetEndpoint / DeactivateFleetEndpoint exactly. The Mapy round-trip test MUST resolve the real IFleetKeyProtector from DI (proves Protect/TryUnprotect symmetry end-to-end), not a fake. Route MUST be admin/fleets/{id:guid}/settings; allowlist entries are constraint-stripped. Depends on WI-1 because the GET browser-key field calls TryUnprotect. Do NOT clobber docs/API-KEYS.md — Edit only §1.3.

work_items.title: API client DTOs+functions + adminTenantSettingsForm pure module (validate/toUpdateRequest/fromDto) with tests
acceptance_criteria: client.ts adds AdminTenantSettingsDto (GET shape: all Fleet+FleetSettings fields, mapyBrowserKey: string | null, mapyServerKeyConfigured: boolean, and NO server-key value field — mirrors the backend GetTenantSettingsResponse), UpdateAdminTenantSettingsRequest (PUT shape: number fields as number, mapyServerKey: string | null, mapyBrowserKey: string | null, other fields typed), getAdminTenantSettings(fleetId: string): Promise<AdminTenantSettingsDto>, and putAdminTenantSettings(fleetId: string, req: UpdateAdminTenantSettingsRequest): Promise<void> — following the existing getAdminFleets/postCreateFleet admin function pattern.

adminTenantSettingsForm.ts exports AdminTenantSettingsFormValues (number fields carried as strings like fleetSettingsForm.ts; booleans as boolean; server key + browser key as string), validateAdminTenantSettingsForm(values) returning a field->i18n-key map (keys under admin.tenant.validation.*, mirrors the server validator bounds), toUpdateRequest(values) producing UpdateAdminTenantSettingsRequest, and fromDto(dto) seeding form values from AdminTenantSettingsDto.

SECURITY-CRITICAL key mapping in toUpdateRequest — for BOTH mapyServerKey and mapyBrowserKey: blank/untouched input -> null (KEEP the existing key), NOT "" (which would CLEAR it). The form has no clear affordance for the server key; blank server-key submit MUST send null. (The API-only ""=clear branch is exercised by backend tests, not the UI.)

fromDto seeds the server-key field BLANK always (the DTO never carries it) and exposes mapyServerKeyConfigured for the page's configured/not-set hint; the browser-key field is seeded from dto.mapyBrowserKey (public).

validateAdminTenantSettingsForm mirrors server bounds: name/phone/timeZone required, currency 3-letter, primaryColorHex ^#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$ when non-empty, offerTimeoutSeconds 10..600, autoDispatchAfterSeconds >=0, maxOfferRadiusKm 1..100, smsMonthlyCapCzk >=0, smsUnitCostCzk >=0, smsSenderName <=100, welcomeText <=2000, mapCenterLat -90..90, mapCenterLng -180..180, mapZoom 1..20, geoMonthlyCreditBudget >=0, mapy keys <=512.
No `any`; explicit return types on exported functions (rules/web-react-style.md#typescript-strict). No fetch/axios outside client.ts.
test_cases: adminTenantSettingsForm.test.ts: validate returns empty map for a valid form; one failing case per bound returning the expected admin.tenant.validation.* key.

adminTenantSettingsForm.test.ts: toUpdateRequest — blank server key -> mapyServerKey: null (KEEP); typed server key -> that value; blank browser key -> mapyBrowserKey: null; typed browser key -> that value. (This is the AC#3/AC#2 keep-on-blank guard — write it as a first-class RED test.)
adminTenantSettingsForm.test.ts: toUpdateRequest converts string number fields to numbers correctly.
adminTenantSettingsForm.test.ts: fromDto seeds server-key field blank, exposes mapyServerKeyConfigured, seeds browser-key from dto.mapyBrowserKey, seeds all other fields.
Gate: npm run tsc clean; npm run lint 0 warnings; npm run test green (verification tool below runs the form test file).
work_items.notes: Pure-logic-first TDD: build and test adminTenantSettingsForm.ts fully before any component. Root of the web lane; WI-4 consumes these exports. Web is built against the agreed JSON contract (see Assumptions) so this WI does NOT depend on the API lane. The single correctness risk is blank=keep for the keys — do not let toUpdateRequest emit "" on blank.

work_items.title: useAdminTenantSettings hooks + AdminTenantSettingsPage + router entry + Edit button + i18n (6 locales) + page/axe tests
acceptance_criteria: useAdminTenantSettings.ts exports useAdminTenantSettings(fleetId) — useQuery with key ['admin','fleets',fleetId,'settings'] calling getAdminTenantSettings — and useUpdateAdminTenantSettings(fleetId) — useMutation calling putAdminTenantSettings; on success invalidate EXACTLY ['admin','fleets',fleetId,'settings'] AND ['admin','fleets'] (never bare invalidateQueries, rules/web-performance.md#query-keys).

AC#1/#5: AdminTenantSettingsPage.tsx reads :fleetId from the route, seeds the form via fromDto (WI-3), renders grouped sections — Fleet (name, phone, currency, timeZone, brand color, active), Dispatch (offer timeout, auto-dispatch enabled + after-seconds, max offer radius), SMS (sender name, monthly cap, unit cost, welcome text), Map & Mapy (browser key, server key, center lat/lng, zoom), Geo (monthly credit budget). All strings via t(); styled-components with theme tokens only; touch targets >= 48 px.

AC#3: the server-key input is type="password", loads BLANK, shows a configured/not-set hint driven by dto.mapyServerKeyConfigured; submitting it blank preserves the stored key (via WI-3 toUpdateRequest blank=null).

AC#5: save banner role="status" aria-live="polite"; field errors role="alert" + aria-invalid on the input; client-side validation via validateAdminTenantSettingsForm before submit; the page ships a vitest-axe test with no violations (import axe from the shared helper).
AC#1 entry: AdminFleetsPage.tsx gains an Edit link/button per fleet row navigating to /admin/fleets/${id}/settings (Link from react-router-dom; the label is an i18n key; touch target >= 48 px).

Route: router.tsx adds { path: '/admin/fleets/:fleetId/settings', element: lazyDispatch(<AdminGuard>{lazyDispatch(<AdminTenantSettingsPage />)}</AdminGuard>) } as a sibling to the existing /admin routes, with a matching lazy import of AdminTenantSettingsPage (rides the existing lazy admin chunk).

AC#7: admin.tenant.* keys (section titles, every field label + helper hint, save/saving/saved/saveFailed, Mapy key hints incl. configured/not-set, and admin.tenant.validation.* messages matching the WI-3 field->key map, plus the AdminFleetsPage Edit label) are added to ALL SIX locale files with real translations (cs-CZ authoritative; neutral formal register — customer/driver tone rules do NOT apply to this operator screen); locales.parity.test.ts passes.
AC#8: npm run tsc, npm run lint (0 warnings), npm run test, npm run build, npm run size all green.

Query-key discipline: invalidate the exact keys only. Add every new key to all 6 locales in this same change (parity test gates it).
